The treatment system consists of coarse screening, extended aeration, settling, chlorination, and discharge to a holding pond.
From the holding pond, wastewater is disposed via spray irrigation on a hillside west of the treatment facility.
Sludge is stored onsite in a polyethylene tank.
From the polyethylene tank, sludge will either be dried on site in a concrete-lined drying bed and the dried biosolids taken to an authorized biosolids disposal facility...
...or pumped from the polyethylene tank as sludge and hauled off site for disposal by a septic pumping service.
